hook_text: If your clothes catch fire, running is the worst thing you can do. Here is why.
clip_script: Firefighters visit a school in Alexandra. Most house fires start with everyday things: a paraffin stove knocked over, a candle near the curtains, a pot of oil left on the stove. So: candles in sand, matches up high, paraffin never in a cooldrink bottle. If there is a fire: shout, get out, crawl under the smoke, never go back. Call 10177 or 112. Clothes on fire? Stop, drop and roll. Burn? Cool water, twenty minutes.
visual_style: Whiteboard fire engine, then a home with hazards circled in red, then a stick figure doing stop, drop and roll.
mood: Serious but empowering, like a hero training session.
pacing: Causes, prevention, then three life-saving actions repeated clearly.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan a fire escape route with your family tonight.
